main.description: Lookup by thread: every conversation in which the caller wrote a MEK or is a MEK recipient, including conversations it has left ([CB-22]), ascending by conversation id. The caller's home DS merges its own conversations with those of every remote sequencer of a conversation the caller takes or took part in (labyrinthRelay listThreads); the remote sequencers are asked in parallel with a per-sequencer deadline and response cap, and a sequencer that cannot answer is named in incomplete instead of failing the call (its conversations are then missing from this page). Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
